raw_user_prompt:
Build a modern full-stack coffee shop e-commerce website with a premium and visually appealing UI. The frontend must be developed using Angular and the backend using Spring Boot. The website should have a fancy and engaging homepage with a sticky header, responsive navbar, and a visually rich hero section with animations and call-to-action buttons. Include 2–3 main pages such as Home, Shop, and Cart.

The homepage should include sections like featured products, coffee categories, brand story, and testimonials with smooth scrolling and hover effects. The UI should follow a dark, elegant, and minimal design inspired by premium coffee brands, with high-quality images and modern typography.

Implement full backend operations including product CRUD APIs, cart functionality, and basic user handling. The cart should allow adding, updating, and removing items. Ensure responsive design, clean layout, and smooth user experience across devices. The code should be production-ready, well-structured, and scalable.
